1: #include "ringbuf.h"
2: #include <stdlib.h>
3: #include <string.h>
4: 
5: struct ringbuf {
6:     uint8_t *buf;        /* allocated storage, capacity bytes */
7:     size_t   capacity;   /* total buffer capacity */
8:     size_t   head;       /* index of oldest byte (next read position) */
9:     size_t   tail;       /* next write position (where to put next byte) */
10:     size_t   count;      /* number of bytes currently stored */
11: };
12: 
13: ringbuf_t *rb_create(size_t capacity)
14: {
15:     if (capacity == 0)
16:         return NULL;
17: 
18:     ringbuf_t *rb = malloc(sizeof(*rb));
19:     if (!rb)
20:         return NULL;
21: 
22:     rb->buf   = calloc(capacity, sizeof(uint8_t));
23:     if (!rb->buf) {
24:         free(rb);
25:         return NULL;
26:     }
27: 
28:     rb->capacity = capacity;
29:     rb->head     = 0;
30:     rb->tail     = 0;
31:     rb->count    = 0;
32:     return rb;
33: }
34: 
35: void rb_destroy(ringbuf_t *rb)
36: {
37:     if (!rb)
38:         return;
39:     free(rb->buf);
40:     free(rb);
41: }
42: 
43: size_t rb_size(const ringbuf_t *rb)
44: {
45:     if (!rb)
46:         return 0;
47:     return rb->count;
48: }
49: 
50: size_t rb_capacity(const ringbuf_t *rb)
51: {
52:     if (!rb)
53:         return 0;
54:     return rb->capacity;
55: }
56: 
57: void rb_clear(ringbuf_t *rb)
58: {
59:     if (!rb)
60:         return;
61:     rb->head = 0;
62:     rb->tail = 0;
63:     rb->count = 0;
64: }
65: 
66: static size_t min_sz(size_t a, size_t b)
67: {
68:     return a < b ? a : b;
69: }
70: 
71: size_t rb_write(ringbuf_t *rb, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
72: {
73:     if (!rb || !data || rb->count == rb->capacity)
74:         return 0;
75: 
76:     /* How much free space */
77:     size_t avail = rb->capacity - rb->count;
78:     size_t n     = min_sz(len, avail);
79: 
80:     if (n <= rb->capacity - rb->tail) {
81:         /* Fits without wrapping past end of buffer */
82:         memcpy(rb->buf + rb->tail, data, n);
83:     } else {
84:         /* Two contiguous copies: tail..end then 0..remainder */
85:         size_t chunk1 = rb->capacity - rb->tail;
86:         memcpy(rb->buf + rb->tail, data, chunk1);   /* [tail .. capacity-1] */
87:         memcpy(rb->buf, data + chunk1,               /* [0    .. remainder-1]  */
88:                n - chunk1);
89:     }
90: 
91:     rb->tail = (rb->tail + n) % rb->capacity;
92:     rb->count += n;
93:     return n;
94: }
95: 
96: size_t rb_read(ringbuf_t *rb, uint8_t *out, size_t len)
97: {
98:     if (!rb || !out || rb->count == 0)
99:         return 0;
100: 
101:     size_t avail = rb->count;   /* bytes already stored */
102:     size_t n     = min_sz(len, avail);
103: 
104:     if (n <= rb->capacity - rb->head) {
105:         memcpy(out, rb->buf + rb->head, n);
106:     } else {
107:         size_t chunk1 = rb->capacity - rb->head;
108:         memcpy(out, rb->buf + rb->head,               /* [head .. capacity-1]   */
109:                chunk1);
110:         memcpy(out + chunk1,                           /* [0      .. remainder-1]*/
111:                rb->buf, n - chunk1);
112:     }
113: 
114:     rb->head = (rb->head + n) % rb->capacity;
115:     rb->count -= n;
116:     return n;
117: }
118: 
119: size_t rb_peek(const ringbuf_t *rb, uint8_t *out, size_t len)
120: {
121:     if (!rb || !out || rb->count == 0)
122:         return 0;
123: 
124:     size_t avail = rb->count;   /* bytes currently stored */
125:     size_t n     = min_sz(len, avail);
126: 
127:     if (n <= rb->capacity - rb->head) {
128:         memcpy(out, rb->buf + rb->head, n);
129:     } else {
130:         size_t chunk1 = rb->capacity - rb->head;
131:         memcpy(out, rb->buf + rb->head,               /* [head .. capacity-1]   */
132:                chunk1);
133:         memcpy(out + chunk1,                           /* [0      .. remainder-1]*/
134:                rb->buf, n - chunk1);
135:     }
136: 
137:     return n;   /* peek does not alter state */
138: }
